regions.today: A largely cloudy evening with some patchy rain.
regions.tonight: Generally cloudy and dry apart from the odd spot of rain. Milder than previous nights with lowest temperatures of 14 to 16 degrees in light to moderate northeasterly winds.
regions.tomorrow: A mix of sunny spells and the odd shower during the morning and afternoon. Heavier rain moving up from the south in the evening bringing a risk of surface flooding. Becoming humid with highest temperatures of 21 to 24 degrees in light to moderate southeasterly winds.
